scope: Phase 3: the nine official SoundCloud albums 'The Music of League of Legends: Season 1-9 (Original Game Soundtrack)', the official 'Warsongs' album, and a snapshot of the official SoundCloud popular-tracks page. Not the complete LoL music catalog.
method: Playlist links point at the official SoundCloud album/page. Per-track links point at the official Spotify album tracks (same pattern as the Creator-Safe Sessions lists), because a SoundCloud set page only exposes its first 15 tracks without JavaScript. Track order/count/title/artist follow the official Spotify album page; Season 1 (9 tracks) and Season 2 (30 tracks) were additionally compared against the official SoundCloud set pages and matched title-for-title in the same order. matchAliases are mechanical prefix truncations of the official title (no invented names).

creatorSafe.description: Riot Games' official Spotify playlist 'Riot Games Creator-Safe Playlist', described as a collection of music that is 100% owned by Riot Games (979 songs at the trk108 check).
creatorSafe.method: Entries 1-100: matched title, artist and order against the official Spotify embed of the playlist, which shows only the first 100 entries: 1-20 = Season 9 (20/20), 21-59 = Season 8 (39/39), 60-100 = the first 41 of Season 7's 48 tracks (checked 2026-10-11; Season 9 was first matched on 2026-10-09 including durations). Entries 101+: the embed stops at 100, so the same playlist was read on songdata.io (see mirror), checked 2026-10-12. It lists the playlist in 50-entry blocks and sorts each block by Spotify track ID, so the exact order inside a block is not visible. Its 51-100 block holds exactly the 50 titles the official embed shows there (the last 9 of Season 8 and the first 41 of Season 7). Its 101-150, 151-200 and 201-250 blocks hold exactly the titles predicted by continuing in album order (Season 7 tracks 42-48, Season 6, Season 5 split 16/9 at 150/151, Season 4, Season 3 split 19/4 at 200/201, Season 2, Season 1), plus 7 singles in the 201-250 block. Every title matched character for character, so the Season 1-7 positions are given as album-order ranges. The playlist uses another Spotify release of these albums (its track IDs differ from the album track IDs linked here), so matching is by title and artist. Warsongs: 10 of 11 tracks are in the 251-300 block under plain titles with the same artists (e.g. 'Piercing Light' by 'League of Legends, Mako'). 'Silver Scrapes' is not among the listed entries. trk116 (2026-10-12) read every row the mirror shows (51-977) and matched all LoL lists: the mirror shows 977 of the 979 entries; its 50-entry blocks stay aligned up to 700 and the 701-750 block shows 48 rows, so the 2 entries it omits sit in positions 701-750 (a 2024-era block). 'Not found' therefore means not among the 977 listed entries.

mirror.readEntries: 51-977 (every row the mirror shows: 977 of 979; 2 omitted in positions 701-750)
mirror.note: Third-party listing of the official playlist (not run by Riot or Spotify). Used only because the official embed shows 100 entries. Its 51-100 block matched the official embed exactly.

soundcloudPlaylists.title: Riot Games Creator-Safe Playlist Pt. I
soundcloudPlaylists.note: Official; linked from Riot's guidelines and the 2020 LoL news post. Last updated about 4 years before 2026-10-12, and holds the older single/remix uploads, not the Season album versions. Only the first 15 entries render; entries 11-15 are Warsongs tracks 1-5 as remix uploads (e.g. 'Piercing Light (Mako Remix)'). Not enumerated.

soundcloudPlaylists.title: Riot Games Creator-Safe Playlist Pt. II
soundcloudPlaylists.note: Official; posted about 4 years before 2026-10-12. Not enumerated.

statuses.verified: every track found in the official playlist
statuses.partial: album: matchedTracks found; notFound lists the titles not among the entries the mirror shows
statuses.links-partial: official link list (tools/leagueoflegends-music-tracklist.json): matchedTracks found; notFound as above
statuses.links-absent: official link list: no track found (matchedTracks 0; notFound lists every title)
statuses.mixed: popular-tracks snapshot: matchedTracks found; notFound lists the rest (mostly collaboration songs)
statuses.unverified: not matched (kept for lists added later; no list uses it now)

evidence.embed: official Spotify embed of the playlist (entries 1-100)
evidence.mirror: songdata.io listing of the same playlist (entries 101+)
evidence.embed+mirror: entries up to 100 from the official embed, the rest from songdata.io
